docs/reference/configuration-guides/logg.16: This new target 404s: https://wiki.ubuntu.com/IptablesHowTo does not exist on the migrated Ubuntu wiki (Special:Search for "iptables" returns only /UFW and /UFW_development), and the legacy help.ubuntu.com/community/IptablesHowTo now redirects there, so the link remains broken. The sibling UFW link on this line works only because wiki.ubuntu.com/UncomplicatedFirewall redirects to /UFW_development. Point iptables at a live authoritative source instead, e.g. https://ubuntu.com/server/docs/how-to/security/firewalls (which documents iptables/ufw and firewall logging), or drop the link.
